title: Quasi-Orthogonal Stabilizer Design for Efficient Quantum Error Suppression
summary: Orthogonal geometric constructions are the basis of many many quantum error-correcting codes (QEC), but strict orthogonality constraints limit design flexibility and resource efficiency. We introduce a quasi-orthogonal geometric framework for stabilizer codes that relaxes these constraints while preserving the symplectic commutation structure on the binary symplectic space $\mathbb{F}_{2}^{2}$.
